scripts.preinstall:
node -e "const [maj]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if(maj<22){console.error('
SplitShot requires Node.js 22+. You are on '+process.version+'.
Run: nvm use
'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @splitshot/shared && npm run build -w @splitshot/web
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @splitshot/shared && npm run postinstall -w @splitshot/web --if-present
